paper_metadata.title: BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
paper_metadata.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be able to perform new tasks based on a few demonstrations or natural language instructions. While these capabilities have led to widespread adoption, most LLMs are developed by resource-rich organizations and are frequently kept from the public. As a step towards democratizing this powerful technology, we present BLOOM, a 176B-parameter open-access language model designed and built thanks to a collaboration of hundreds of researchers. BLOOM is a decoder-only Transformer language model that was trained on the ROOTS corpus, a dataset comprising hundreds of sources in 46 natural and 13 programming languages (59 in total). We find that BLOOM achieves competitive performance on a wide variety of benchmarks, with stronger results after undergoing multitask prompted finetuning. To facilitate future research and applications using LLMs, we publicly release our models and code under the Responsible AI License.

extraction_data.innovation: Open-access multilingual language model: trained on 46 languages and 13 programming languages using a diverse dataset of 410GB of text from Pile21, C4, and CommonCrawl, differing from prior models by providing unrestricted open-access with behavioral-use clauses (RAIL license) to limit harmful applications while maintaining community availability; Causal language modeling objective: standard next-token prediction trained on a massive multilingual corpus to achieve state-of-the-art multilingual text generation and understanding.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: ROOTS dataset (341B tokens) plus 25B tokens of repeated data.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Multitask prompted finetuning, Multilingual multitask finetuning
extraction_data.research_problem: Open-access multilingual language modeling at scale.
extraction_data.application: Multilingual text generation, sentence embeddings, classification, semantic textual similarity (STS), morphosyntactic feature prediction
extraction_data.paper_title: BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
extraction_data.finetuning_data: xP3, P3 (Public Pool of Prompts), Multitask dataset (13B tokens), xP3 corpus
extraction_data.supported_language: 46 natural languages, 13 programming languages, Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Esperanto, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Swahili, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese, Yoruba, Zulu, Galician, Basque, Marathi, Tagalog, Welsh, Bambara, Wolof
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Multi-head self-attention, Multi-head attention with Alibi positional embeddings, Multi-head self-attention with causal masking
extraction_data.benchmark_result: SuperGLUE 1-shot: Ax-b, CB, WSC, WiC; WMT'14 zero-shot BLEU: en→fr 15.38, fr→en 14.15, en→hi 1.90, hi→en 10.19; WMT'14 1-shot BLEU: en→fr 36.39, fr→en 36.56, en→hi 14.49, hi→en 24.60; DiaBLa 1-shot BLEU: 37.6 (en→fr), 41.4 (fr→en); COMET: 0.634 (en→fr), 0.757 (fr→en); WikiLingua ROUGE-2 F-measure (1-shot); Flores-101 spBLEU (1-shot); HumanEval pass@1 (comparable to GPT-3 175B); HELM benchmark (on par with GPT-3 davinci v1); HELM benchmark: accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, bias, toxicity; HumanEval: 560M(0.82%), 1.1B(2.48%), 1.7B(4.03%), 3B(6.48%), 7.1B(7.73%), 176B(15.52%); XNLI, XWinograd, XCOPA, XStoryCloze
